modules.title: Introduction to Ilu I (Proverbs)
modules.html:
Common Igbo proverbs and their meanings. This section covers introduction to ilu i (proverbs).

Key points

  • Gịnị bụ 'Ilu' n'asụsụ Igbo — Mmanụ e ji eri okwu.
  • Gịnị ka ilu a pụtara: 'Ụjụjụ riri nne ya ka ọ ga-ata nwa ya ụta?' — Na mmadụ agaghị ata onye meruru ya ahụ ụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị n'ọbara ha.
  • Gịnị bụ 'Ilu' — Mmanụ e ji eri okwu.
  • Ilu: 'Chọọ ewu ojii...' — Mgbe chi ka dị.
  • Mezuo ilu a: 'Ọkụkọ sị na ihe ya ji-ele anya n'elu mgbe ọ na-aṅụ mmiri bụ ...' — ...i ji kelee Chineke..

Worked examples

Q: Gịnị bụ 'Ilu' n'asụsụ Igbo?
A: Mmanụ e ji eri okwu — Based on Chinua Achebe's definition, proverbs (ilu) are the palm oil with which words are eaten.

Q: Gịnị ka ilu a pụtara: 'Ụjụjụ riri nne ya ka ọ ga-ata nwa ya ụta?'
A: Na mmadụ agaghị ata onye meruru ya ahụ ụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị n'ọbara ha — This proverb emphasizes accountability or lack thereof when dealing with inherent traits or internal family issues.

examples.q: Gịnị ka ilu a pụtara: 'Ụjụjụ riri nne ya ka ọ ga-ata nwa ya ụta?'
examples.a: Na mmadụ agaghị ata onye meruru ya ahụ ụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị n'ọbara ha

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ilu' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Based on Chinua Achebe's definition, proverbs (ilu) are the palm oil with which words are eaten.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka ilu a pụtara: 'Ụjụjụ riri nne ya ka ọ ga-ata nwa ya ụta?'
options: Na mmadụ agaghị ata onye meruru ya ahụ ụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị n'ọbara ha
Na mmadụ agaghị eri nne ya
quiz.solution: This proverb emphasizes accountability or lack thereof when dealing with inherent traits or internal family issues.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ilu'?
quiz.solution: According to Chinua Achebe, proverbs (ilu) are the palm oil with which words are eaten.

quiz.q: Ilu: 'Chọọ ewu ojii...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Mgbe chi ka dị.

quiz.q: Mezuo ilu a: 'Ọkụkọ sị na ihe ya ji-ele anya n'elu mgbe ọ na-aṅụ mmiri bụ ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: ...i ji kelee Chineke..

quiz.q: Mezuo ilu a: 'Agadi nwaanyị ranye nká, ọ sị na nwa ya ___'?
options: ọ kụghị ya ihe ọ mụtara
ọ sị na ọ gaghị amụ nwa
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: ọ kụghị ya ihe ọ mụtara.

quiz.q: Mechaa ilu a: 'Onye tụwa mma n'isi ___'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: ya atụla ya n'ebe ọzọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Akpalaokwu' (Idiom)?
options: Okwu nwere nghọta miri emi dị iche na mkpụrụasụsụ ndị ahụ
quiz.solution: Idioms are expressions where the meaning is not deducible from the literal words.

quiz.q: Ịgba mgba n'ala Igbo bụ _____.
quiz.solution: Wrestling (Ịgba mgba) is a traditional sport used to determine strength and bring honor to one's community.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Abụ'?
options: Okwu a kpara akpa nwere nhazi na udaolu
quiz.solution: Poetry (Abụ) consists of rhythmic, well-organized speech often using figurative language.

quiz.q: Onye na-akpụ isi bụ onye _____.
quiz.solution: In Igbo grammar, the person who cuts hair is simply 'onye na-akpụ isi'.

quiz.q: Onye bụ nna asụsụ Igbo nke oge a?
quiz.solution: F.C. Ogbalu is widely regarded as the promoter/father of modern Igbo studies.

quiz.q: Mmadụ ole na-alụ di na nwunye n'ala Igbo n'oge gboo?
options: Otu nwoke na otu nwanyị nani
quiz.solution: Historically, polygamy (ịlụ karịa otu nwaanyị) was common and often a sign of wealth/status.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka 'Oji' na-anọchite anya ya n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Kola nut (Oji) is the ultimate symbol of welcome and peace.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Market'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ahịa.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Water'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Mmiri.

quiz.q: Eji gịnị aga ije?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ụkwụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Male'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nwoke.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Sleep'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ụra.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe bụ 'Ụdaolu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Tone marking.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ala'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Land/Earth.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Akpa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Bag.

quiz.q: Cika wannan karin maganar: 'Kowa ya duka ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: ...shi zai tsinta..

quiz.q: Wanne ne daidai: 'Yarinya ... kyau'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Mai.

quiz.q: A ina ake gudanar da 'Durbar'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Fada (Palace).

quiz.q: Menene 'Sarkin Musulmi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Sultan.

quiz.q: Kedu onye dere akwụkwọ 'Omenuko'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Pita Nwana.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Red' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Uhie.

quiz.q: Olee akụkụ ahụ mmadụ e ji anụ ihe?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ntị.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe 'Mgbakwunye' pụtara?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Affix.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Mmetara' (Personification)?
options: Inye ihe na-adịghị ndụ agwa mmadụ
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Inye ihe na-adịghị ndụ agwa mmadụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Child'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Nwa.
